_about: A real Gemini run on Vertex AI, recorded by `python -m server.cli agent`. Fixture mode replays the tool calls through the same tools (no Gemini call) and shows the texts only if every replayed result matches this recording.
final_text: I have created 7 ingest proposals covering unused DEBUG logs, successful health checks, duplicate timeout warnings, high-cardinality metric dimensions, worker heartbeats, PII redaction, and static asset spans. In total, these proposals offer an estimated monthly saving of €1,619 (751 GiB) awaiting human approval. All telemetry backed by guardrails, dashboards, notebooks, alerts, or SLOs—such as checkout INFO logs, audit records, and active business spans—were strictly protected and left untouched. For the recurring expired model weights ERROR in the recommendation service, I recorded a finding recommending that the issue be fixed at the code level rather than suppressing error logs.

result.matcher_dql: service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO" and matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user")
result.otel_collector_yaml:
processors:
  transform/sift-email-app-info-sent-confirmation-to-1f3c:
    error_mode: ignore
    log_statements:
    - context: log
      conditions:
      - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "email" and log.attributes["log.source"] == "app" and log.severity_number >= SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO and log.severity_number < SEVERITY_NUMBER_WARN and IsMatch(log.body, "(?i)Sent +confirmation +to +user")
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(log.body, "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+[.][A-Za-z]{2,}", "***@***")
